registration.welcome: Welcome to Artania! You have arrived in a time of great trials. Once a flourishing kingdom, Artania now suffers from a terrible blight — the Beastfever. The Crown seeks bold souls ready to defend our lands and restore peace to these realms. Before the King issues his decree and bestows upon you the powers of Governor, we must know who stands before us. What is your name, warrior?
registration.nickname.edge_space: ❌ Name can't start or end with a space.
registration.nickname.consecutive_spaces: ❌ No more than one space in a row.
registration.nickname.invalid_chars: ❌ Letters, digits and single spaces only — no symbols, emoji or punctuation. Use Latin or Ukrainian letters.
registration.name_accepted: Greetings, %{name}! Your name is now inscribed in the royal register of Artania. The Kingdom of Artania, once famed for its peaceful hamlets, now withers under the Beastfever, which twists forest dwellers into savage brutes. Your duty as Governor is to rebuild a derelict estate and cleanse the land of this scourge, to bring life back to the ravaged realm. To fulfil this mission you must choose your path:
registration.class.prompt: Which caste will you take up for your stewardship?
registration.class.warrior.desc: the unbreakable shield of the kingdom. You rely on heavy armour and tempered steel to meet the rabid beasts face-to-face and defend your estate in close combat.
registration.class.archer.desc: the keen eye of Artania. Your edge is speed and precise shots from afar, cutting down infected beasts before they ever reach your borders.
registration.class.mage.desc: master of ancient powers. You wield magic to burn the plague with spells or weave wards that cleanse the land and turn back the fiercest predators.
registration.king_oath: The King steps forward and lays a hand on your shoulder: «From this day, you are a Free Governor of Artania. This charter grants you right to an estate and a parcel of land. But I know well — paper will not stop a beast, and law will not guard you from fangs.» The King signals to his servants, and they bring forth a bundle: «Beyond the land, I grant you a weapon. It is the symbol of your authority and the only true defence of your new home. This %{weapon} is now yours. May it never rust, as your heart knows no fear. Go to your estate, Governor. Cleanse the land, raise the walls, and restore Artania to her former glory!»
registration.journey_wolves: The road to your new lands wound through twisted ravines and silent forests. As the silhouette of your manor's old tower appeared on the horizon, the path was suddenly blocked — by them. A pack of rabid wolves burst out from beneath the roots. Their fur is matted, foam drips from their jaws, and their eyes hold nothing but blind fury. They do not wait — they lunge at you all at once, scenting fresh blood and steel.
registration.wolves_retry: 🩸 You scrambled away — but the wolves still bar the path. Steel yourself and try again.
registration.estate.prompt: Above the entrance to the manor hangs an old plaque, untouched by human hands for ages. You wipe the dust and grime from it. Now that you have proved your claim to this land by the strength of arms, you must give this place a new name. From this day on, it shall be a symbol of Artania's rebirth. %{name}, what will you name your estate?
registration.estate.edge_space: ❌ Estate name can't start or end with a space.
registration.estate.consecutive_spaces: ❌ No more than one space in a row.
registration.estate.invalid_chars: ❌ Letters, digits and single spaces only — no symbols, emoji or punctuation. Use Latin or Ukrainian letters.
registration.complete: ✅ Welcome, %{nickname}! Class: %{class} Estate: %{estate} May Artania rise again beneath your shield.

item.food.forest_berries.desc: Sweet juice that slightly eases hunger and restores a bit of vigour.
item.food.forest_nuts.desc: Nutritious and light — a true treasure for a scout!
item.food.potato.desc: A strategic resource — not meant to be eaten raw, but the cornerstone of any future household.
item.food.duck_egg.desc: A nutritious find from wild duck nests — can be eaten raw for a quick bite. Also used as an ingredient in the Kitchen for cooked dishes.
item.food.raw_meat.desc: The primary source of protein, taken from successful hunts in the forests of Artania.
item.food.baked_potato.desc: A simple potato pulled from hot ash — the cornerstone of every peasant table.
item.food.roasted_meat.desc: A cut of meat seared over coals. Simple, hearty, no pretensions.
item.food.foragers_omelette.desc: A whisked omelette with forest nuts and a hint of berry — a meal for someone who knows where to forage.
item.food.hunters_stew.desc: A thick stew of meat, potato, and egg. The kind of cooking anyone learns after three weeks alone in the woods.
item.food.meat_ragout.desc: A slow-stewed pot of meat, potato, and crushed forest nuts. Earthy and rich — the kind of meal that fills the kitchen with warmth long before it reaches the table.
item.food.berry_tart.desc: A sweet tart of berries and nuts. Rare on the forest path, a holiday at the table.
item.food.governors_feast.desc: A feast worthy of an estate-master: meat, potato, eggs, berries, nuts — all on one platter.
item.mat.pine_lumber.desc: The foundation of your prosperity. Artanian pines stand tall and rich with resin, so their wood resists rot for years.
item.mat.river_pebble.desc: Smooth stones from the riverbed — perfect for laying a foundation or building a new hearth.
item.mat.clay.desc: A pliable building material used to seal the walls and finish the hearth of your estate.
item.mat.iron.desc: A small lump of raw iron — a fingertip-sized nugget pulled straight from the rock. Smelt ten in the workshop to forge a single Iron Ingot.
item.mat.iron_ingot.desc: A forged bar of clean iron — ten lumps' worth of work, stamped and ready for the smith. The base material for any serious gear.
item.mat.hide.desc: A valuable material taken as a trophy from a fallen wild or rabid beast.
item.gear.rusty_sword.desc.t1: A corroded blade with a scratched flat. King's gift — coarse, but all yours.
item.gear.rusty_sword.desc.t2: Rust scrubbed off, the metal speaks again. The steel rings true.
item.gear.rusty_sword.desc.t3: Properly honed edge, balanced grip. Cuts cleaner with every swing.
item.gear.rusty_sword.desc.t4: Spine reforged at the manor anvil. Tempered, oiled, ready.
item.gear.rusty_sword.desc.t5: Master-class smithing. The guard bears your forge-mark — the blade carries your name.
item.gear.simple_bow.desc.t1: Coarse-grained wood, plain bowstring. King's gift — a weapon to start with.
item.gear.simple_bow.desc.t2: Bark stripped, the grip smoothed under your palm. The arrow flies straighter.
item.gear.simple_bow.desc.t3: Sinew-strung now — the pull harder, the snap quicker.
item.gear.simple_bow.desc.t4: Layered limbs glued with resin. A composite frame; lighter, faster, deadlier.
item.gear.simple_bow.desc.t5: A long hunter's bow, polished to a sheen. Every shot finds its mark.
item.gear.wooden_staff.desc.t1: A plain branch, the bark still half-green. Magic flows through it raw, unfocused.
item.gear.wooden_staff.desc.t2: Runes carved along the shaft. The wood begins to hold the spell.
item.gear.wooden_staff.desc.t3: A focusing crystal mounted at the tip. Your fire stays where you point it.
item.gear.wooden_staff.desc.t4: Bound with arcane wire that hums in your palm. The rod answers your thoughts.
item.gear.wooden_staff.desc.t5: A heartwood core of ancient bone. Spells resonate and amplify themselves.
item.gear.forester_hood.desc: Soft leather hood, supple enough to keep silent in the brush. Light protection — but better than your scalp bare.
item.gear.forester_jerkin.desc: A sleeveless leather jerkin, cured to take a glancing blow. The forester's first line of defense.
item.gear.forester_breeches.desc: Tanned hide trousers — broken in by mud, root, and the long miles of the trail.
item.gear.forester_boots.desc: Soft-soled leather boots — quiet on stone, kind to the ankle on broken ground.
item.artifact.recipe.foragers_omelette.d: Notes from a forest cook. Eggs, nuts, a pinch of berry — the kind of meal for a long, wet camp.
item.artifact.recipe.hunters_stew.desc: A page torn from someone's trail journal. A stew that goes on the fire at dawn and finishes late at night.
item.artifact.recipe.meat_ragout.desc: A scroll splattered with grease — someone scribbled the recipe down while still stirring the pot. Practical, rustic, hard-won.
item.artifact.recipe.berry_tart.desc: Kitchen paper in a careful hand — a tart for feast days, not for the ordinary table.
item.artifact.recipe.governors_feast.des: An ornate parchment stamped with an estate seal. Not just a dish — a showcase of everything the year has brought home.

capital.blocked_by_expedition: 🏕 Your governor is away in the wilderness. The capital is two days' ride — the road waits for another day.
capital.welcome: 🏛 The Capital is the heart of the kingdom, where life never stills, day or night. Merchants haggle in the bustling bazaar, artisans hammer out blades and armour, and in the tavern there is always a tankard of ale and a fresh rumour. In the arena, fighters earn glory and gold, while a mysterious fortune teller whispers prophecies to those bold enough to ask about their fate. And over it all, the King himself watches closely from the royal palace.
capital.location.market.title: 🛒 The Bazaar
capital.location.market.body: Stalls line both sides of the square — leather, herbs, scraps of armour, scrolls of dubious origin. Governors and refugees haggle in the same breath. (The player marketplace will open here once trade lands.)
capital.location.arena.title: ⚔️ The Arena
capital.location.arena.body: Wooden tiers ring a sand pit dark with old stains. Posted on the gate: rules of single combat, sealed with the Crown's wax. (Matchmaking and ranked duels will arrive with the PvP patch.)
capital.location.trader.title: 💼 The Trader
capital.location.trader.body: A wiry old man behind a worn counter — wares stacked floor to rafters. He buys what you don't need and sells what you can't find. (Buy / sell prices and inventory rotation coming next.)
capital.location.fortune.title: 🔮 The Fortune Teller
capital.location.fortune.body: A dim tent reeking of smoke and dried lavender. The old woman lifts her eyes from the cards without surprise — as if she's been waiting. (Daily blessings, hint quests, and risk readings on the way.)
capital.location.master.title: 🛠 The Master
capital.location.master.body: A workshop louder than a forge — wood, iron, leather, glass all under one roof. The master barely glances up: «Show me what you need fixed.» (Repairs, reforging, and enchanting will live here.)
capital.location.tavern.title: 🍺 The Tavern
capital.location.tavern.body: The «Royal Seal» Tavern is the perfect place to rest in Artania. Here you can fill up on roasted meats hot off the spit, sip a cool ale by the fireplace, test your aim at darts, or win a few coins rolling dice at the gaming table.

travel.to_estate.started: You turn toward home. Arrival in %{remaining}.

travel.cannot_start.no_vigor: 😵 You are too exhausted for the road. Eat first.
exploration.blocked_in_capital: 🏛 The wilderness only borders your estate. Return home before you set out hunting.
capital.trader.intro: The Trader is a respected merchant from the capital of the Kingdom of Artania, whose shop has long been a known landmark among Governors. From him you can buy everything you need for your estate or for exploring, and sell your own resources and goods. The Trader is famed for his honest scales, reliable bargains, and a knack for finding a buyer even for the rarest of wares. «Show me what you've brought. And take a look at what I've got today...»
capital.trader.bag_full: Bag is full — %{free} slot(s) free, need %{need}.
capital.trader.sell_empty: Your bag holds nothing the trader will buy. Go hunting first.
capital.tavern.dice_subtitle: Place a wager. Both roll two dice. Higher sum wins. A tie refunds the wager.
capital.tavern.darts_subtitle: Place a wager. Both throw two darts. Higher score wins. A tie refunds the wager.

exploration.resumed: 🌲 You are still deep in the forest.

exploration.outcome.nothing.revisited: 🍂 The trail is thinner than before — most of what was here is gone.
exploration.outcome.nothing.bare: 🌫 The room is as still as you left it. Nothing stirs.

exploration.find.mat.pine_lumber: 🌲 You found a fallen pine, ideally suited for carpentry.
exploration.find.mat.river_pebble: 🪨 You noticed smooth stones in the water, worn flat by the current.
exploration.find.mat.clay: 🧱 You raked through damp soil and struck a seam of pure, pliable clay.
exploration.find.mat.iron: 🔩 A glint between the roots — a small lump of iron, no bigger than a thumbnail.
exploration.find.food.forest_berries: 🫐 In the thickets you spotted a scatter of ripe forest berries.
exploration.find.food.forest_nuts: 🌰 Under a dense hazel canopy you found a scatter of ripe nuts in hard shells.
exploration.find.food.potato: 🥔 You dug through damp earth and uncovered a large, intact tuber.
exploration.find.food.duck_egg: 🥚 In a tucked-away nest among the reeds you spotted a fresh duck egg.

combat.encounter.intro: %{enemy} bursts out of the underbrush. Your move?
combat.enemy.crit: %{enemy} lands a savage blow. You take %{damage} HP.
combat.defend.absorbed: You hold the line and tag %{enemy} for %{damage} HP.
combat.defend.barrier: A magic barrier shimmers around you.
combat.flee.success: You break away from %{enemy} and fall back.
combat.flee.fail: %{enemy} catches you mid-retreat — %{damage} HP in the back.
combat.in_progress: You're locked in combat with %{enemy}. Finish the fight first.
combat.super.warrior.activate: Bloodlust takes hold — your eyes go red, and your blade hungers. (+ATK, +DEF, ×2 vigor drain for %{rounds} rounds.)
combat.super.archer.activate: Hawk's Eye sharpens — every breath slows, every shadow betrays its prey. (+crit, +accuracy, +dodge for %{rounds} rounds.)
combat.super.mage.activate: Arcane Resonance unfurls — the air shimmers as your weave answers. (×1.5 attack damage, +DEF for %{rounds} rounds.)
combat.super.warrior.expire: The frenzy fades. The world comes back into focus.
combat.super.archer.expire: Your focus loosens. The forest is just a forest again.
combat.super.mage.expire: The weave settles. The air falls still.
combat.super.already_active: A stance is already burning through you. Let it run its course.
combat.special_atk.warrior.hit: Your cleave splits %{enemy}'s guard for %{damage} HP.
combat.special_atk.warrior.crit: The cleave shatters bone — %{enemy} reels for %{damage} HP.
combat.special_atk.warrior.miss: Your cleave bites only air as %{enemy} staggers aside.
combat.special_atk.archer.hit: The arrow finds the gap — %{enemy} takes %{damage} HP.
combat.special_atk.mage.hit: Soulfire blooms in your palm and scorches %{enemy} for %{damage} HP.
combat.special_atk.mage.crit: The flame reaches the soul — %{enemy} burns for %{damage} HP.
combat.special_def.warrior.activate: You plant your shield and brace — %{enemy}'s blow rings off the iron, and your counter chips them for %{damage} HP. Your next swing will find their armor already split.
combat.special_def.archer.activate: You melt into the underbrush — %{enemy}'s strike finds nothing but shadow. The veil lingers; you remain hard to pin.
combat.special_def.mage.activate: A mirror ward shimmers around you — %{enemy}'s blow rebounds, scoring them for %{damage} HP.
combat.special_def.mage.no_damage: The ward holds — %{enemy}'s blow glances off, finding no purchase.

combat.tech.locked: You haven't learned this technique yet. Visit the Training Ground at your estate once you reach level %{level}.
